title: Repeat-Delinquency Principal Share on a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Credit and Collections policy — principal added when a Patient Payment Plan falls behind again**

A repeat-delinquency principal share of one installment is added to the catch-up for a plan with an earlier delinquency: where an installment outside the current delinquency was recorded as missed within the last 12 months, the share is 0.1; where every earlier missed installment fell before that period, the share is 0.05; where the current delinquency holds the plan's only missed installments, nothing is added. The amount added is the installment in force multiplied by the share.

Missed installments are placed by their due dates. An installment lies within the last 12 months when the whole calendar months between its due date and the handling date number fewer than 12.

## Table

| The plan's missed installments outside the current delinquency | Share of one installment added |
|---|---|
| At least one within the last 12 months | 0.1 |
| One or more, all before the last 12 months | 0.05 |
| None (the current delinquency holds every missed installment of the plan) | Nothing |

## Hypothetical readings (installment in force 150.00)

- An installment missed 7 months ago, outside the current delinquency: 15.00 is added.
- The only earlier missed installment fell 16 months ago: 7.50 is added.
- The plan has never missed an installment before the current delinquency: nothing is added.
